risk_note: RV2 by default for .github/** (class-3 protected path; owner label needed per #24). Adds only .github/dependabot.yml (规划/05 CT-23): version 2; one npm entry at directory '/' (the pnpm workspace is covered by the root lockfile); weekly schedule (Monday 09:00 Asia/Shanghai); cooldown default-days and semver-major / minor / patch days all 7, matching ADR-0001 §2 (install only versions released at least 7 days ago) and pnpm-workspace.yaml minimumReleaseAge 10080; one minor-and-patch group (update-types [minor, patch], no narrowing keys); open-pull-requests-limit 5; commit-message prefix chore(deps). There is no ignore and no automatic merge or approval, and dependency PRs still go through a deps task and an adversarial review. No code, lockfile, workflow or package.json change. Whether cooldown applies to pnpm will be observed after enabling; the orchestrator records the result in the planning repo's ADR-0001 §7. Rule tests by a fresh independent Claude (approvals #36) statically pin the config shape and scan the workflows for auto-merge; red PASS on the spec commit (8 red, 0 problems). Implementation by an Opus 5.5 subagent in one run. verify:fast exit 0. Full verify on the test machine (verify/1): exit 124 at the 3600 s limit with no failing case before it (the dependabot rule tests are unit tests and passed in verify:fast); recorded per D10-319, CI verify-int is the check.
